criteria: Every evaluable validation video: official-mask-trained Fly reader mean target recall>=.50 and false-positive rate on non-target support inside detector box<=.10. Empty or absent denominator is unknown. Publish all invalid/ambiguous detector requests.

With 3 fixed seeds averaged per query, Fly official reader mean IoU exceeds both matched R1 and geometry alone in overall video-balanced mean and on at least 2 of 3 validation scenes. RGB, box-prior and equal-label comparisons reported.

Change labels only (dense instance vs box-fill proxy) and test whether official labels reduce false positives inside the box without sacrificing overall IoU. At least 4 independent training videos and 2 evaluable validation videos, no overlapping video IDs, no core inference.
selection: Train: all stored detector-candidate boxes from 39 exact aligned feature examples on eight distinct MOTS training videos. Val: all intersections of archived native FlyVis and official exact clocks: seven maps, three videos. For each map take up to two class2 detections with confidence>=0.25, center inside eye, sorted by normalized distance from eye center then raw index. Use only each video/frame/box/crop once per split; same crop with different neural history kept explicitly as a distinct input, results averaged first across identical physical requests. Assign reference truth via best nonignore car/truck/bus instance bbox overlap >=.50 and explicit unique winner; missing/ambiguous excluded from supervised target IoU and counted. This is an ROI-conditioned instance-mask task, not recognition of a lost public ID.
model: Frozen Fly34 and frozen normalized retinal history34. Per-cell own+mean6 neighbors+coordinates relative to supplied bbox (70 inputs); RGB expanded only by zero-padding; geometry with zero signal. Same 70-32-3 ReLU reader, 200 full-batch Adam steps lr .01; seeds42,43,44; train-only standardization; equal training scenes, instances and classes. Native inside/outside bit not supplied; no threshold search. Obtain output from class argmax. Compare official vs rectangular proxy on same requests. Fixed 90% class-purity criterion on 13x13 eye footprints, unknown ignored; scope of evaluation grid limited to convex eye support.
scope: Fixed research readers only; no new neural core or tracker run. Validation videos independent of training the reader, not completely new to the whole project.
